name: Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea for CodeSupply
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: We appreciate suggestions for new parsers, risk rules, or visual features!
  - type: textarea
    id: feature-description
    attributes:
      label: Feature Description
      description: Clear and concise description of the proposed feature.
    validations:
      required: true
